pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1, 8.8.1.3.1 and 8.8.1.3.1.1 (standard intermediate data item, 'a precision of 32 decimal digits', rounding to 31; the PB5575 gap is the compiler's 34). They govern the evaluation of an arithmetic expression only. SR1 only names operand-1/2/3; it states no evaluation. No dependence.

behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.CompileTimeArithmeticImplementorDefined, src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Expressions/CompileTimeArithmetic.cs#For) picks only the mode in which a compile-time arithmetic expression is evaluated: Standard at 2002, as §2002:7.2.5.2 GR1 requires ('Standard arithmetic shall be used for all arithmetic operations'). SR1 is descriptive (it names operands/subjects); the evaluation mode of an arithmetic-expression operand is §2002:7.2.5's, not this rule's. eval_basic.cob re-run now at --std 2002 prints every leg OK (rerun.log).
